QUOTE: "None of these are in `library/`. The library itself spawns nothing." and "Per-object locks... `library/threading.c`" with "`mbedtls_threading_key_slot_mutex` (`threading.c:188`)"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads, but it frames the mutex code as compiled out by default and never says that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction for threaded callers. It describes the locks as internal protections, not as an abstraction offered to callers.
